name: fedora-bible
description: A full-featured local Bible reader with multi-translation support, full-text search, multi-tab reading, highlights, and notes.

scripts.import:kjv: node scripts/import-translation.js --code KJV --name "King James Version" --dir data/sources/kjv --year 1769 --publicDomain true
scripts.import:tr: node scripts/import-midvash.js --code TR --name "Textus Receptus (Stephanus 1550/Scrivener 1894)" --dir data/sources/tr --language grc --year 1894 --publicDomain true --sourceNote "Greek New Testament, public domain"
scripts.import:wlc: node scripts/import-midvash.js --code WLC --name "Westminster Leningrad Codex" --dir data/sources/wlc --language hbo --year 2008 --publicDomain true --sourceNote "Hebrew Old Testament (Masoretic Text), free-distribution license via tanach.us"
scripts.import:lxxe: node scripts/import-usfm.js --code LXXE --name "Septuagint, Brenton English translation (1851)" --dir data/sources/lxx-en --language en --year 1851 --publicDomain true --sourceNote "English translation of the Greek Septuagint by Sir Lancelot C. L. Brenton; 39 protocanonical OT books"
scripts.import:lxxg: node scripts/import-swete.js --code LXXG --name "Septuagint (Swete edition, Greek)" --dir data/sources/lxx-gr --language grc --year 1930 --publicDomain true --sourceNote "Old Testament in Greek according to the Septuagint, ed. H.B. Swete; word-level data via Open Greek and Latin Project (CC BY-SA 4.0); 36 of 39 protocanonical books"
scripts.import:pesh: node scripts/import-translation.js --code PESH --name "Peshitta (Syriac New Testament)" --dir data/sources/peshitta --language syr --year 1905 --publicDomain true --sourceNote "British and Foreign Bible Society Syriac NT critical edition (1905/1920), public domain; text via scrollmapper/bible_databases"
scripts.import:cops: node scripts/import-translation.js --code COPS --name "Coptic New Testament (Sahidic)" --dir data/sources/coptic-sahidic --language cop --publicDomain true --sourceNote "Sahidic Coptic New Testament (3rd-4th c. translation); digital transcription via scrollmapper/bible_databases, CC BY-SA (attribution + share-alike)"
scripts.import:peshot: node scripts/import-translation.js --code PESHOT --name "Peshitta Old Testament" --dir data/sources/peshitta-ot --language syr --publicDomain false --sourceNote "Vetus Testamentum Syriace critical edition (Peshitta Institute Amsterdam/Brill) where published, Codex Ambrosianus otherwise; text via ETCBC/peshitta. CC BY-NC -- noncommercial use only; commercial use requires permission from the Peshitta Institute/Brill."
scripts.import:avd: node scripts/import-pipedelim.js --code AVD --name "Van Dyck (Arabic)" --file data/sources/vandyck-ar/vandyck.txt --language ar --year 1865 --publicDomain true --sourceNote "Smith & Van Dyck Arabic translation, completed 1865, public domain; text via github.com/EtkAppsAdmin/Bibles-1"
scripts.setup: npm run db:init && npm run import:kjv && npm run import:tr && npm run import:wlc && npm run import:lxxe && npm run import:lxxg && npm run import:pesh && npm run import:cops && npm run import:peshot && npm run import:avd && npm run pwa:seed
